record.paper_title: Open problems in ageing science: A roadmap for biogerontology
record.original_question: What mechanisms determine the exceptional longevity of long-lived species?

evidence.quote: What mechanisms determine the longevity of long-lived species?

artifact.self_contained_problem: Across the animal kingdom, maximum lifespan varies by several orders of magnitude: some species (e.g., certain whales, tortoises, naked mole rats, and bivalves such as Arctica islandica) live for centuries or display negligible senescence, while closely related species live only a few years. Identify and characterize the molecular, cellular, physiological, genetic, and evolutionary mechanisms that determine the exceptional longevity of long-lived species. Specifically: (i) determine which biological processes (e.g., DNA repair fidelity, telomere maintenance, proteostasis, mitochondrial function, tumor suppression, immune surveillance, stem cell dynamics) are causally responsible for extended lifespan in such species; (ii) identify the genomic, transcriptomic, and proteomic features that distinguish long-lived species from short-lived relatives; and (iii) determine which of these mechanisms are conserved or convergent across independently evolved long-lived lineages, and to what extent they could in principle be transferred or induced in shorter-lived species including humans.
artifact.status_search_result: Comparative biogerontology research has identified candidate mechanisms (enhanced DNA repair, high-molecular-weight hyaluronan in naked mole rats, improved proteostasis, distinct mitochondrial features, tumor-suppressor duplications such as TP53 copies in elephants, etc.), but a comprehensive causal account of why long-lived species live so long remains unresolved and is widely listed as an open problem in current ageing-science roadmaps.

status_evidence.title: Comparative biology of longevity (review)
status_evidence.snippet: Comparative studies have uncovered species-specific adaptations contributing to longevity, but the full set of mechanisms underlying exceptional lifespan remains incompletely understood.
status_evidence.claim: Mechanisms of exceptional species longevity are partially characterized but not fully resolved.

status_evidence.title: Naked mole-rat longevity mechanisms
status_evidence.snippet: Studies highlight high-molecular-weight hyaluronan, improved proteostasis, and cancer resistance as contributors, while many determinants remain unknown.
status_evidence.claim: Only a subset of longevity-determining mechanisms have been identified in long-lived species.
